description:
Get Stock Expert AI's research summary for one US-listed stock: MoonshotScore (0-100 against frozen sector norms, an educational risk and quality rating, not a return forecast), band (Exceptional / Strong / Fair / Weak), grade, which scoring engine produced it, the five pillar scores (0-100; 50 = the sector's typical company; weights Quality 22, Safety 18, Valuation 18, Growth 20, Momentum 22), the engine's one-line read, one-sentence bull and bear case, score and analysis dates, next provider-listed earnings date and the canonical page URL. Price, market cap and P/E are not returned: full figures on the page (canonicalUrl).

Covers one ticker per call, e.g. "what does Stock Expert AI say about NVDA", "NVDA MoonshotScore", "NVDA bull vs bear case".

Args: ticker (string) — US ticker symbol.
Returns (structuredContent): { ticker, company, exchange, sector, industry, moonshotScore|null, grade, band, scoreEngine, scoreAsOf, pillars: [{ pillar, score, state }], strongestPillar, weakestPillar, scoreRead, bullCase, bearCase, analysisDate, nextEarningsDate, figuresAsOf, canonicalUrl, fullFigures, disclaimer }.
Errors: "No summary for <ticker>" when the ticker is unknown or its page is too thin to publish. Funds/ETFs/warrants/SPACs carry no MoonshotScore (moonshotScore = null).
Derived output only: Stock Expert AI's own ratings, sentences and dates. Raw market figures (price, market cap, P/E, EPS, revenue) are not returned — full figures on the page (canonicalUrl).
MoonshotScore is Stock Expert AI's educational research rating, not a buy or sell recommendation. Not financial advice. Not a registered investment adviser.

ticker.description: US ticker symbol, e.g. NVDA, BRK.B, AAPL (case-insensitive)

name: stockexpertai_get_stock_summary
title: Stock Expert AI: stock summary (MoonshotScore)
